g.title: Accepts PDF, image and email; returns a receipt ID.
Immutable original, content hash as key.
One message per document; dead-letter after 3 attempts.
Durable steps: parse, extract, validate, decide, post.
Text, tables and coordinates per page.
Structured output against the document schema, with page coordinates per field.
Supplier lookup, VAT check, PO match, arithmetic.
Every field, its source coordinates, confidence and rule results.
Shows the failing field beside the document region.
Receives posts with an idempotency key.
Throughput, queue age, cost per document.
